corrections.reason: The verb agrees with the singular subject Balaam from the end of the previous page ('በለዓምንስ ቁሞ ረግሞ ቢያጠፋ'), and the glyph on the page is clearly the 4th-order 'ፋ' (parallel to L02 'ቢያጠፋ'), not 'ፉ'.
Before the 3rd-person masculine singular object suffix '-ው', the verb stem takes the 1st-order 'ሰ' ('ቢያንሰው'), which matches the straight-legged glyph in the image.
Standard 3rd-person masculine singular perfective 'ዠመረ' (consistent with L01, L03); the image shows 'ረ' with a slight ink break on the top curve.
The printed character is the 1st-order 'የ' ('ብየ'), with both legs of equal length.
The 3rd-person masculine singular gerundive is 'ሂዶ' ('he having gone, they having gone...'), and the top ring of 'ዶ' is visible in the image.
The Amharic distributive prefix 'እያ-' ('እያሳዘልኸ', parallel to L33 'እያሲያዝህ' and Col 4 L07 'እያሳዘለ') begins with 6th-order 'እ', not 3rd-order 'ኢ'.
